ProductOrder Inventory Kafka API 1.0.0
  • application/json

The ProductOrder inventory publishes and consumes events on and from different topics.

  • Publish productOrderStateChanged event.
  • Publish productOrderAttributeValueChange event.
  • Receive real-time event about product delivery.
  • Receive commands message from product order capture microservice in order to update productOrder state and attributes into the POI.

Servers

  • http://localhost:9092kafkadevelop

    Localhost development server

    Security:
    security.protocol:PLAINTEXT
  • kafka-integration-disco.apps.fr01.paas.tech.orangekafkaintegration

    Integration server

    Security:
    security.protocol:PLAINTEXT

Operations

  • PUB disco.order-management.productOrderChange-command

    The topic on which productOrder change command may be produced by another microservice and consumed by the product order inventory. This topic is internal to the OrderManagement component.

    Commands to change the state or the attribute of a particular productOrder.

    Operation IDpublishProductOrderChangeCommand

    Available only on servers:

    • develop
    • integration
    object
    groupId
    output-group-1
    x-scs-function-name
    productOrderChangeCommandPublishEvent

    Accepts the following message:

    Product order change command

    A command for the microservice "product order inventory" to update the state or any attribute of a specific product order.

    • application/json
    object allOf
    uid: https://orange.com/productOrderCommand.yaml
    required
    object [ProductOrderPayloadCommand]
    uid: https://orange.com/productOrderPayloadCommand.yaml
    required
    object [ProductOrder]
    uid: https://event.com/productorder.yaml

    A Product Order is a type of order which can be used to place an order between a customer and a service provider or between a service provider and a partner and vice versa.

    id
    string

    Unique identifier.

    href
    string

    Hyperlink reference.

    cancellationDate
    string
    format: date-time

    Date when the order is cancelled. This is used when order is cancelled.

    cancellationReason
    string

    Reason why the order is cancelled. This is used when order is cancelled.

    category
    string

    Used to categorize the order from a business perspective that can be useful for the OM system (e.g. "enterprise", "residential", ...)

    completionDate
    string
    format: date-time

    Date when the ProductOrder was completed.

    description
    string

    Description of the product order.

    expectedCompletionDate
    string
    format: date-time

    Expected delivery date amended by the provider.

    notificationContact
    string

    Contact attached to the order to send back information regarding this order.

    priority
    string

    A way that can be used by consumers to prioritize orders in OM system (from 0 to 4 : 0 is the highest priority, and 4 the lowest)

    requestedCompletionDate
    string
    format: date-time

    Requested delivery date from the requestor perspective

    requestedStartDate
    string
    format: date-time

    Order fulfillment start date wished by the requestor. This is used when, for any reason, requestor cannot allow seller to begin to operationally begin the fulfillment before a date.

    object [Product]

    A product offering procured by a customer or other interested party playing a party role. A product is realized as one or more service(s) and / or resource(s).

    id
    string

    unique identifier.

    @baseType
    string

    When sub-classing, this defines the super-class.

    href
    string

    Hyperlink reference.

    description
    string

    Is the description of the product. It could be copied from the description of the Product Offering.

    isBundle
    boolean

    If true, the product is a ProductBundle which is an instantiation of a BundledProductOffering. If false, the product is a ProductComponent which is an instantiation of a SimpleProductOffering.

    isCustomerVisible
    boolean

    If true, the product is visible by the customer.

    name
    string

    Name of the product. It could be the same as the name of the product offering.

    orderDate
    string
    format: date-time

    Is the date when the product was ordered.

    productSerialNumber
    string

    Is the serial number for the product. This is typically applicable to tangible products e.g. Broadband Router.

    startDate
    string
    format: date-time

    Is the date from which the product starts.

    terminationDate
    string
    format: date-time

    Is the date when the product was terminated.

  • PUB disco.order-management.productOrderStateChange-event

    Publishing product order state change event

    Operation IDproductOrderEventProducer

    Available only on servers:

    • develop
    • integration
    object
    groupId
    output-group-1
    x-scs-function-name
    productOrderEventConsumerPublishEvent

    Accepts the following message:

    Change event about the product order state.

    This event is about the productOrder state change. This event is often published following a successful update of the product order state in the product order inventory.

    • application/json
    object allOf
    uid: https://orange.com/productOrderStateChangeEvent.yaml
    required
    object [ProductOrderPayloadEvent]
    uid: https://orange.com/productOrderPayloadEvent.yaml
    required
    object [ProductOrder]
    uid: https://event.com/productorder.yaml

    A Product Order is a type of order which can be used to place an order between a customer and a service provider or between a service provider and a partner and vice versa.

    id
    string

    Unique identifier.

    href
    string

    Hyperlink reference.

    cancellationDate
    string
    format: date-time

    Date when the order is cancelled. This is used when order is cancelled.

    cancellationReason
    string

    Reason why the order is cancelled. This is used when order is cancelled.

    category
    string

    Used to categorize the order from a business perspective that can be useful for the OM system (e.g. "enterprise", "residential", ...)

    completionDate
    string
    format: date-time

    Date when the ProductOrder was completed.

    description
    string

    Description of the product order.

    expectedCompletionDate
    string
    format: date-time

    Expected delivery date amended by the provider.

    notificationContact
    string

    Contact attached to the order to send back information regarding this order.

    priority
    string

    A way that can be used by consumers to prioritize orders in OM system (from 0 to 4 : 0 is the highest priority, and 4 the lowest)

    requestedCompletionDate
    string
    format: date-time

    Requested delivery date from the requestor perspective

    requestedStartDate
    string
    format: date-time

    Order fulfillment start date wished by the requestor. This is used when, for any reason, requestor cannot allow seller to begin to operationally begin the fulfillment before a date.

    object

    BillingAccount reference. A BillingAccount is a detailed description of a bill structure.

    Consuming ProductOrderStateChangeEvent to create the product order follow-up event

    Operation IDproductOrderEventConsumer

    Available only on servers:

    • develop
    • integration
    object
    groupId
    input-group-1
    x-scs-function-name
    productOrderEventConsumer

    Accepts the following message:

    Change event about the product order state.

    This event is about the productOrder state change. This event is often published following a successful update of the product order state in the product order inventory.

    • application/json
    object allOf
    uid: https://orange.com/productOrderStateChangeEvent.yaml

    object [ProductOrder]
    uid: https://event.com/productorder.yaml

    A Product Order is a type of order which can be used to place an order between a customer and a service provider or between a service provider and a partner and vice versa.

    id
    string

    Unique identifier.

    href
    string

    Hyperlink reference.

    cancellationDate
    string
    format: date-time

    Date when the order is cancelled. This is used when order is cancelled.

    cancellationReason
    string

    Reason why the order is cancelled. This is used when order is cancelled.

    category
    string

    Used to categorize the order from a business perspective that can be useful for the OM system (e.g. "enterprise", "residential", ...)

    completionDate
    string
    format: date-time

    Date when the ProductOrder was completed.

    description
    string

    Description of the product order.

    expectedCompletionDate
    string
    format: date-time

    Expected delivery date amended by the provider.

    notificationContact
    string

    Contact attached to the order to send back information regarding this order.

    priority
    string

    A way that can be used by consumers to prioritize orders in OM system (from 0 to 4 : 0 is the highest priority, and 4 the lowest)

    requestedCompletionDate
    string
    format: date-time

    Requested delivery date from the requestor perspective

    requestedStartDate
    string
    format: date-time

    Order fulfillment start date wished by the requestor. This is used when, for any reason, requestor cannot allow seller to begin to operationally begin the fulfillment before a date.

  • #1Change event about the product order attribute value change.

    This event is about the product order attribute value change. This event is often published following a successful update of the product order attribute value.

    • application/json
    Message IDproductOrderAttributeValueChange
    object allOf
    uid: https://orange.com/productOrderAttributeValueChangeEvent.yaml
    required
    object [ProductOrderAttributePayloadEvent]
    uid: https://orange.com/productOrderAttributePayloadEvent.yaml
    required
    object [ProductOrder]
    uid: https://event.com/productorder.yaml

    A Product Order is a type of order which can be used to place an order between a customer and a service provider or between a service provider and a partner and vice versa.

    id
    string

    Unique identifier.

    href
    string

    Hyperlink reference.

    cancellationDate
    string
    format: date-time

    Date when the order is cancelled. This is used when order is cancelled.

    cancellationReason
    string

    Reason why the order is cancelled. This is used when order is cancelled.

    category
    string

    Used to categorize the order from a business perspective that can be useful for the OM system (e.g. "enterprise", "residential", ...)

    completionDate
    string

    string

    Unique identifier.

    format: date-time

    string

    format: date-time

    format: date-time

    format: date-time

    format: date-time
